name: ZZ Plant
hook: Glossy, nearly unkillable, and fine in your darkest corner.

steps.title: Water every 2–3 weeks
steps.tip: Its potato-like rhizomes store water, so wait until the soil is completely dry.

steps.title: Low light is fine
steps.tip: It handles offices and dim rooms; just keep it out of direct afternoon sun.

steps.title: Fast-draining soil
steps.tip: Use potting mix with a handful of perlite so the rhizomes never stay wet.

steps.title: Yellow leaves? Too wet
steps.tip: Overwatering rots the rhizomes. Let soil dry fully and check for mushy roots.

steps.title: Repot when crowded
steps.tip: Size up only when rhizomes crowd the pot; go just one pot size bigger.

outro: Less water, less fuss. The ZZ thrives on being ignored.

sources.title: NC State Plant Toolbox: Zamioculcas zamiifolia
